verdict.rationale: Poly documents search inside files, using natural-language queries that resolve down to the page, paragraph, timestamp or frame. That search is available from the CLI and also covers visual similarity. Poly also has tags that sync with Finder, but no evidence shows search filters on tags, properties or paths, or that search works offline (the desktop folder only downloads files on demand). Missing for 10: tag/property/path filters in search, offline search, evidence of instant full-text (keyword) search, independent corroboration.
